note:
22 -> 20, and both units are real computes; the third line of the diff is a rename.

An exact ratchet fails on an unbanked improvement the same as on a regression,
which is what this was: both fixes landed in other sessions' commits and neither
moved the floor.

Offender sets diffed name by name between a detached worktree at 8b8a26297b0 --
the commit that set 22 -- and one at HEAD, with line numbers normalised out so a
file that merely moved does not read as two units:

  removed  addons/crm/wizard/crm_merge_opportunities.py   _compute_team_id
  removed  addons/event/models/res_partner.py             _compute_event_count
  renamed  addons/account_payment/wizards/payment_refund_wizard.py
        -> addons/account_payment_provider/wizards/payment_refund_wizard.py
           _compute_has_pending_refund, unchanged and still counted; the module
           was renamed by aad8a7b4da9, so subtracting the two paths would read
           as one removal and one addition rather than as the net zero it is.

crm ran `search_count` on crm.team once per wizard record to ask whether the
chosen user is on the chosen team; that test is now `crm.team._get_team_for_user`
and the loop body is a single call. event ran a `child_of` `search_count` on
event.event once per partner; it is now one `_read_group` over
event.registration keyed by partner and event, plus one query per level of the
contact hierarchy -- res.partner is not a `_parent_store`, so the ancestors are
walked rather than read off a materialised path.
